artikel.titel: The Commodities Feed: Copper hits six-month low; improving supply weighs on oil
artikel.text: Base metals remained under pressure this morning as a firmer dollar and concerns over Chinese demand weighed on sentiment. Oil also edged lower, with recovering supply and rising US inventories outweighing renewed geopolitical tensions

artikel.titel: FX Daily: Commodity complex is having a moment
artikel.text: The dollar is bid across the board as a strong US economy and above-target inflation keeps expectations of another 75bp in Fed tightening alive. At the same time, commodity currencies are starting to underperform as industrial metals and energy take a leg lower. Investors are yet to lean into another decent leg higher in the dollar, but that is the risk

artikel.titel: Rates Spark: Testing the AI narrative
artikel.text: The focus remains on the AI narrative, with the Anthropic IPO another test for broader sentiment. Positive news is a precondition for rates to move higher again. But rates are defying the bearish backdrop for now, with oil prices also seemingly disconnected from headlines of new military strikes in the Middle East

artikel.titel: National Bank of Hungary review: The doves aren’t gone yet
artikel.text: CENTRAL AND EASTERN EUROPE: The National Bank of Hungary kept rates unchanged in November, but delivered a dovish twist. A rate cut was already on the table, and improving domestic risk sentiment is creating more room for manoeuvre. Nevertheless, we only see the next cuts coming in late 2027 as inflation pressures rebuild

artikel.titel: CCA macro and credit: Stronger credits, more selective opportunities
artikel.text: CAUCASUS AND CENTRAL ASIA: The Caucasus and Central Asia (CCA) region has become a more resilient, better-rated, and more accessible market for investors. But following a strong rally, improving fundamentals no longer guarantee attractive returns. In this report, we link sovereign ratings, strategy, and macro resilience, while initiating coverage of Kyrgyzstan

artikel.titel: US retail sales and manufacturing suggest strong momentum
artikel.text: UNITED STATES: The details of the October retail sales and industrial production reports are more encouraging than the headline figures alone suggest. Strip out volatile components and it is apparent consumer spending remains firm, while advanced manufacturing in the US is surging thanks to tech capex, a strong economy, energy security and potentially also tariffs

artikel.titel: Germany’s hidden advantage in the AI race
artikel.text: EUROPE: Berlin may be Germany’s innovation powerhouse, but across Europe, the country is still playing catch-up. When it comes to AI, however, it could have much more up its sleeve than its overall innovation performance suggests

artikel.titel: The Commodities Feed: Metals under pressure while oil supply improves
artikel.text: Oil remains under pressure as Middle East supply recovers, while aluminium tightness keeps nearby spreads elevated. Copper and iron ore continue to face pressure from a softer demand backdrop

artikel.titel: Rates Spark: Can AI confidence bring rates back up?
artikel.text: Nvidia will announce its quarterly earnings today, followed a day later by Anthropic's IPO, two major AI events. Macro has become closely intertwined with AI sentiment and therefore positive and negative surprises should not be ignored by the bond market. Having said that, we think fading spillovers to euro rates will often make sense

trendfolge.regel: Absolute Momentum, 3 Monate (63 Handelstage), täglich entschieden (Antonacci 2014: 12 Monate, monatlich)
trendfolge.hinweis: Täglich entschieden und 3 statt 12 Monate Rückschau sind eigene Wahl, das Paper entscheidet monatlich über 12 Monate. Beides bringt mehr Fehlsignale, wenn der Markt schnell dreht. Keine Anlageberatung.
